tools.name: sarcire_preview
tools.description: Get a quick fix preview for a build or runtime error. Returns whether a vector-matched fix exists and a one-line summary. Fast and free — use this before every retry.

error_text.description: Full error output (stderr / stack trace). Up to 50 000 chars.

context_id.description: Optional correlation ID (PR number, build ID, etc.).

tools.name: sarcire_get_fix
tools.description: Retrieve the full step-by-step fix for an error. Call after sarcire_preview confirms a match exists. Credits required for novel generation.

error_text.description: Full error output. Up to 50 000 chars.

fix_id.description: Optional: retrieve a specific fix by vector ID from sarcire_preview.

tools.name: sarcire_check_plan
tools.description: Generate a structured remediation plan for an error. Returns ordered steps with a safety verdict (LIKELY_SAFE | VERIFY_FIRST | KNOWN_BAD_PATTERN).

error_text.description: Full error output. Up to 50 000 chars.

max_steps.description: Max plan steps to return (1-10, default 5).

tools.name: sarcire_report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether a fix resolved the error. Improves fix quality over time. Call after applying any fix from sarcire_get_fix.

query_decision_id.description: UUID from the sarcire_preview or sarcire_get_fix response.

outcome.description: Whether the fix resolved the error.

new_error_trace.description: If negative and a different error appeared, paste it here.

tools.name: sarcire_submit_fix
tools.description: Contribute a new fix to the Sarcire corpus. Fixes are reviewed for correctness and safety before indexing.

error_text.description: The error this fix resolves. Up to 50 000 chars.

fix_summary.description: One-line description of the fix (10-200 chars).
